description: This file defines the ContentType interface within the Todaymade\Daux\ContentTypes namespace, specifying methods for content type handling such as retrieving supported extensions and converting raw content. It appears to be part of a content processing library used in the Daux documentation generator.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Interface for content types, requiring implementation of methods to get supported file extensions and to convert raw content into output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Config object, likely for initialization purposes.

methods.description: Converts raw text and a Content node into a processed string output.
